distinct_chars_documented.İ: Turkish dotted capital I -> 'i' + U+0307 under lower(); not folded to plain 'i'. (Both Python lower() and ICU lower(value COLLATE und) agree on this.)
distinct_chars_documented.ﬁﬂﬀﬃﬄ: Latin ligatures stay composed (not expanded to fi/fl/ff); 'ﬁle' != 'file'. NFC (not NFKC) is the frozen policy, so compatibility decompositions are not applied.
distinct_chars_documented.Ａ-Ｚａ-ｚ０-９: Fullwidth Latin/digits stay fullwidth; 'ＡＢＣ' != 'ABC'. NFC does not compatibility-fold fullwidth forms (NFKC would).
distinct_chars_documented.⁰¹²³: Superscript digits stay distinct; '²' != '2'. (NFC, not NFKC.)
distinct_chars_documented.a/а/α: Homoglyphs are NOT folded: Latin 'a' (U+0061), Cyrillic 'а' (U+0430), and Greek 'α' (U+03B1) remain three distinct compact keys. Confusable folding is a separate, riskier transform that would merge unrelated identities; it is deliberately absent.
